title: Vintage Jose Canseco Oakland A's 1991 Framed Photo Display Plaque
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Vintage Sports Memorabilia:Photos
descriptionText:
Vintage pre owned condition. Frame shows light surface wear and small scuffs consistent with age. Backing paper has wear and a partially torn original store label. Glass is intact with no cracks noted. Please review all photos closely for condition details.

Vintage Jose Canseco Oakland Athletics framed display dated 1991.
This wall display features a large action photograph of Jose Canseco batting, two mounted Jose Canseco baseball cards, an Oakland A’s emblem, and an engraved metal nameplate reading
Jose Canseco
Oakland A’s
1991
The display is mounted on green felt backing inside a decorative wood frame with carved detailing. Original backing board and wall hanger are present.
This is a classic early 1990s sports memorabilia piece that displays very well and makes a great addition to an A’s fan or Canseco collection.
Measurements
Overall frame size
Approximately 19 inches wide x 15 inches tall
Frame depth
Approximately 1.25 inches
Contents included
Large Jose Canseco action photo
Two Jose Canseco baseball cards mounted
Oakland A’s logo emblem
Engraved metal nameplate
Wood frame with glass front
Original backing and hanger
